title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of 2:1 for the intensity ratio.

title: Nuclear Spin Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the significance of the nitrogen nucleus having spin I = 1 and its implications for the total nuclear spin of the molecule.

title: Degeneracy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the degeneracy ratios for the adjacent rotational levels based on the nuclear spin states.

title: Transition Rule Mention
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the transition rule of ΔJ = 2 and its relevance to the spectral lines.

title: Bose-Einstein Statistics
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss how the N2 molecule obeys Bose-Einstein statistics and its effect on the wave function.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the degeneracy or misunderstanding the implications of nuclear spin.

title: Heat Distribution Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the neglect of heat distribution effects at room temperature in the context of spectral line intensities.
